name: Adventures in Research!
source:
Adventures in Research! is an interactive choose-your-own-adventure game that introduces information literacy concepts to university students. Concepts covered include: creating a research question, evaluating sources, database searching, plagiarism, and tips on presenting information. The game is divided into six Acts, and each Act focuses on one or two topics.

You play as a student (entering a name of your choice) working on a research paper for your class over the course of a month.
translation:
研究中的冒险！是一款交互式选择冒险游戏，旨在向大学生介绍信息素养概念。涵盖的概念包括：创建研究问题、评估来源、数据库搜索、抄袭以及呈现信息的技巧。游戏分为六幕，每一幕集中一两个主题。

你扮演一名学生（输入你选择的名字），在一个月的时间里为你的班级写一篇研究论文。
